# Generated inference fixture

`generated-body.png` was created locally using OpenCV circles, polygons and thick lines during the October 28, 2026 inference investigation. It is an illustration with no human photograph, camera capture or patient data. There is no physical reference measurement. The verification script preserves its digest in the result receipt and translates the pixels for a repeatable image-response check.

A different generated drawing was not detected (`dist/fullproject-20261028/D-actual-model/receipt.json`). That failure is retained: successful detection of this fixture does not establish general detection reliability or physical accuracy. No detection must remain UNAVAILABLE.
